instruction: You are given an NREL 5 MW OpenFAST reference model. Complete a deterministic extreme-operating-gust analysis from the command line. 1. Write `/home/user/Desktop/build_case.py` and create `/home/user/Desktop/eog.wnd`, an InflowWind uniform time-series file sampled every `0.1 s` from 0 to 60 s. Use baseline speed `11.4 m/s`; for `10 <= t <= 20.5 s` use `V(t)=11.4+7.5*(1-cos(2*pi*(t-10)/10.5)) m/s`, returning to baseline afterward. Set all wind-direction, vertical-speed, shear, and gust columns to zero. 2. Create `/home/user/Desktop/eog_inflow.dat` from the supplied InflowWind file with `WindType=2`, `FileName_Uni="eog.wnd"`, and `RefHt_Uni=90 m`. Create normalized `elasto_eog.dat`, `aero_eog.dat`, and `servo_eog.dat` module files; request native ElastoDyn channels `RootMyb1` and `TTDspFA`. Create `/home/user/Desktop/eog_case.fst` with `TMax=60`, `DT_Out=0.1`, `OutFileFmt=1`, and references to the generated files. 3. Run `/home/user/miniconda3/bin/openfast eog_case.fst`, retain `/home/user/Desktop/eog_case.out`, and save the console output as `/home/user/Desktop/eog_case.log`; require normal termination. 4. Write `/home/user/Desktop/postprocess.py`. Over `10 <= t <= 30 s`, compute the maximum absolute `RootMyb1` in kN-m and maximum absolute tower-top fore-aft displacement `TTDspFA` in m. Save `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` as `rootmyb1_peak_knm,ttdspfa_peak_m`. Do not use GUI tools. [Init Package Note] Additional initialization dependencies are pre-uploaded under `/home/user/Desktop` with relative structure preserved. Only initialization inputs are included; no answer/result artifacts are preloaded.
